Emotional '100% AI' stories travel: minchoi's personalized song + visual for a special day 29.8K, and 'a couple growing old together... this couple doesn't even exist' 16.5K.
Control-pipeline hooks keep earning saves: techhalla '3D blockout gives you the control. AI handles the final look. full Magnific workflow' 11.4K / 173 bookmarks (~1.5% save rate).
Decade swap day 4 is fading: techhalla 'God of War but it's 1976' 8.4K / 336 likes, down from 55-66K over the previous three days.

Model tests/news fill the mid-tier: azed_ai Kling Image 4.0 native 8K test 6.6K, 400B open-weights video model + LoRAs 7.2K, SenseNova U1 Pro ranking 26.6K (only 21 likes). Outsider meta: 'This AI video is an Absolute Masterpiece (Grok Imagine 4.7)' reposts and PopNow promos, low reach.
